purpose: Held E21 LOOP successor comparing the sealed judge-targeted re-listen plan with its matched seeded-random plan. The plans are sealed predecessor component comparisons: they do not claim live initial-draft or judge selection. Every one of the 1,593 fixed windows over 44 calls is delivered; only 600 windows per arm are contacted for selective re-listen and the remainder are delivered from the sealed predecessor.

population.selection: no draw: the whole frozen earnings21-original discovery split -- the same 44 calls, the same 1,593 fixed 90-second windows and the same split identity the sealed comparator, KC-E1, KU-E1c, KC-E1f and the null replicate all flew. The E5 split (34 kb-construction, 10 r4-e21-sub10 evaluation) is a REPORTING split; the evaluation ten carry 342 paired windows, below the program's n >= 400 rule, and are reported apart and descriptively.
population.estimand: per-entity-class ConEC-mirror entity WER, pooled over all 44 calls, paired at the 90-second window and clustered at the call. EVERY window is delivered by both arms -- a flagged one repaired, an unflagged one from the predecessor -- so the paired read is over the same 1,593 units as KC-E1f's, never over the contacted subset.

predecessor.why_it_is_not_reflown: KC-E1f's reason, unchanged: the comparator already decoded every one of these windows and its bytes ARE pass 1. Re-flying pass 1 would double the contacts and -- because greedy decoding on llama-server is not bitwise reproducible across batch compositions -- would produce a pass 1 that is NOT the arm this cell is paired against.
predecessor.what_it_additionally_carries_here: the DRAFT the Reviewer criticised. The selective plan's flags were computed model-free on these exact sealed per-window hypotheses, so the binding is what makes the plan and the flight describe the same text; a binding that failed to verify would invalidate the plan as well as the repair.

gain_definition.interpretation: Positive gain means X has lower WER than Y; all PERSON admission and targeting bounds use this orientation.

decision.primary: Admission requires LB90 gain(judge-plan over sealed direct baseline) > 0, LB90 gain(judge-plan over KC-E1f) >= -0.25009, and realized generation calls <= 50% of 1,593. Targeting is a separate attribution requirement: LB90 gain(judge-plan over matched-random twin) > 0.
guards: delivery integrity: every delivered window equals its sealed predecessor outside accepted substitution spans and preserves its identical whitespace-token count; abort the read on any violation.
window coverage: all 1,593 windows are delivered exactly once, contacted or back-filled; abort the read on any violation.
corpus WER non-inferiority: UB90(judge-plan WER - sealed baseline WER) <= +0.05793.
numeric-value accuracy non-inferiority: LB90(judge-plan accuracy - sealed baseline accuracy) >= -0.15651.
over-generation non-inferiority: UB90(judge-plan minus sealed baseline) on insertion rate in percentage points (100 times insertions divided by reference words) <= +0.022178.
negation-critical error rate: report the inherited taxonomy ID as advisory only; the null interval excludes zero, so this carrier cannot resolve that clause.
decision.claim_surface: Discovery component comparison only; no live initial-draft/judge-selection claim, no superiority or Stage-3 claim.
decision.improvement: In addition to admission and all guards, an improvement over KC-E1f requires LB90 gain(judge-plan over KC-E1f) > 0; targeting remains a separate attribution conclusion.
